title: Tiny, cute crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#F2A93B'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldlite' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFF2B8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FFD34D'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- crown base band -->
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='60' height='16' rx='5' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='60' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#goldlite)'/>
  <!-- band gems -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='70' r='4' fill='#F04E6E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='4.5' fill='#3EC6E0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='70' r='4' fill='#F04E6E'/>
  <!-- crown points -->
  <polygon points='20,62 20,30 33,48 43,26 50,44 57,26 67,48 80,30 80,62' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <polygon points='20,62 20,30 33,48 43,26 50,44 57,26 67,48 80,30 80,62' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- point highlights -->
  <polygon points='20,34 22,56 30,50 36,40' fill='#FFF2B8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='80,34 78,56 70,50 64,40' fill='#FFF2B8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tip pearls -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='29' r='4' fill='#B8F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='25' r='4' fill='#B8F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='25' r='4' fill='#B8F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='29' r='4' fill='#B8F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='29' r='2' fill='#EEF9FF'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='25' r='2' fill='#EEF9FF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='25' r='2' fill='#EEF9FF'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='29' r='2' fill='#EEF9FF'/>
  <!-- center top jewel -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#8E5BE0'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#D8C2FF'/>
</svg>
